answer: A verifier stakes money behind each identity it vouches for, and its bond rises $50 per identity, so the tenth costs $500 and the hundredth $5,000. A cipher on each attestation ties the verifier to that identity. An ember call each epoch makes 5% of agents answer a 60-second live check or lose the bond. Three auditors recheck the willow registry every 48 hours. A forged cipher or missed ember call prunes the branch, voids the bond, and zeroes every identity it touched. Forging 100 clones costs $252,500 against $50 for one honest agent. A hundred fake passports cost a hundred real vaults.
